forecaster_note: Sun: SE/E swell mix, head high at the south exposures and waist–chest elsewhere; offshore and clean in the morning, onshore and lumpy from later morning. Mon: peaky waist–chest, clean-ish AM at south magnets/north corners, NE'lies and junky later. Tue: weak, waist–chest, average; S-facing cleanest in the morning. Wed: worth a look early, peaky chest high. — Surfline forecaster (Anthony Spinks), Sun 18 Oct

wind.summary: Light W offshore ~6 kph at dawn through ~9am — clean. Swings onshore E ~13 kph by noon, ~15 kph arvo, 17–22 kph by evening. Clear and cool.

shark.summary: Tagged White Shark #2855 detected at North Steyne (Manly) ~8h ago (10:07pm Sat). Only Northern Beaches detection in the last 24h — none at Palm Beach, Curl Curl, Dee Why or Long Reef. Feed is current (newest statewide detection ~30 min ago, South West Rocks; ~34 real detections statewide in 24h). DPI feed returned no features. Tagged-shark pings are receiver detections, not sightings — check the live map before paddling out, and weigh Manly carefully.
